summary: Genius Sports Ltd, a Guernsey-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting to be held December 8, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. GMT in London and virtually, with proxy deadline December 4, 2026. The filing attaches the AGM notice and form of proxy; the Chair recommends shareholders vote in favor of each resolution, all to be decided by poll. This is a routine meeting notice with no transactional terms, advisors, or special-situation mechanics; no deal or corporate-action angle to monitor.
